|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">ヴィルダー・ブリンは典型的な反乱軍偵察兵で、前線偵察がその任務だ。即時対応戦術の訓練を受けており、多くは反乱軍に参加する以前に特殊部隊で経験を積んでいる。</span>
|translation='''Title''' — [[Rebel Scout]].

'''Lore''' — Vildar Blin is a typical Rebel scout, and front-line reconnaissance is his assignment. Trained in first-response tactics, many gained special-forces experience before joining the Rebellion.

'''Game text''' — You may move as a react without spending Force to an adjacent location where you have a Rebel with ability greater than 2 or a leader.
|translation_note=Japanese does not say the react is to a battle. 位置 vs site. リアクション vs 'react'. フォースを消費せずに vs for free. Lore assigns him to front-line reconnaissance rather than usual recon missions.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-rebelscout-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Rebel Scout]].</ref>
